translations.web: Won’t the day of Yahweh be darkness, and not light? Even very dark, and no brightness in it?
translations.bsb: Will not the Day of the LORD be darkness and not light, even gloom with no brightness in it?
translations.kjv: Shall not the day of the LORD be darkness, and not light? even very dark, and no brightness
translations.asv: Shall not the day of Jehovah be darkness, and not light? even very dark, and no brightness in it?
